content.title: Telangana Pollution Control Board Recommends Closures and Forfeitures Over Dusty Construction
content.caption: The Telangana Pollution Control Board (TGPCB) has recommended closure orders and forfeiture of bank guarantees for construction projects due to dust emissions.

slides.heading: Telangana Pollution Control Board Recommends Closures and Forfeitures Over Dusty
slides.text: The Telangana Pollution Control Board (TGPCB) has recommended closure orders and forfeiture of bank guarantees for construction projects due to dust emissions.

slides.heading: Complaints and Task Force
slides.text: The Telangana Pollution Control Board received complaints about air pollution caused by dust emissions from construction projects in Tellapur and Kollur areas of Sangareddy district.

slides.heading: Task Force Recommendations
slides.text: The Task Force recommended closure orders against projects with serious violations and forfeiture of bank guarantees for minor violations.
